name: news-digest
description: A digest of the news of RSS or Atom feeds on a topic, sent on a schedule.
guidance: Attach the read_feed tool. In task_prompt, name the feed addresses to read (from the known feeds that match the topic, or the ones the user gives), how many items to keep and the format: one line per item with its title and its link.
agent_instructions: Copy every link exactly as the feed gives it, character for character; never rebuild a link from a date or a title.

questions.purpose: Which topic should the digest cover?
questions.schedule: When should I send the digest (for example every day at 8:00)?

name: page-watch
description: Watch a web page and say what changed since the last check, on a schedule.
guidance: Attach the fetch_page tool. In task_prompt, give the page's https address and what kind of change matters.
agent_instructions: Read the page with fetch_page, compare it with what you saved in your memory at the last run, say only what changed (or that nothing changed), then save what you saw for the next run.

questions.task_prompt: Which page should I watch (its https address), and what kind of change matters?
questions.schedule: How often should I check it (for example every 6 hours)?

name: reminder
description: Remind the user of something at a time or on a schedule.
guidance: No tool. The task_prompt is the reminder itself, as the user wrote it.
agent_instructions: Send the reminder you are given in one or two short, friendly sentences. Use no tool.

name: daily-summary
description: A short report each day on a subject the user chooses, such as a morning briefing.
guidance: Use a daily schedule. In task_prompt, say what the report covers and its length.
agent_instructions: Keep the report short: a title line, then at most five points.

questions.purpose: What should the daily report cover?
